environment.note: Static visual backdrop only; no navigation, collision or gameplay environment integration.

assets.name: Briarling
assets.description: A crooked little root creature with a carved seed mask, thorn fingers and a fern collar.
assets.damagePlan: Next pass: a quick chest recoil, leaf shake and small bark chips. Its amber eyes remain visible during hit flashes.
assets.attackPlan: Next pass: a low two-claw swipe, with a clear crouch before the lunge.

assets.name: Sporecaller
assets.description: A squat forest fungus with a broad plum cap, luminous gills, dangling spore pods and soft, ringed feet.
assets.damagePlan: Next pass: the cap compresses and rebounds, the body squashes, and a few harmless spores scatter.
assets.attackPlan: Next pass: the gills brighten before a lobbed spore attack and a visible landing circle.

assets.name: Thornback
assets.description: A low, broad woodland boar, with overlapping slate-bark armor, curling ivory tusks and thorn-covered shoulders.
assets.damagePlan: Next pass: a heavy shoulder jolt and pale chips on armored hits. The exposed face and flank give clearer damage feedback.
assets.attackPlan: Next pass: it digs in, lowers its tusks, then charges along a clearly marked lane.

assets.name: Hollowhart
assets.description: An ancient antlered tree guardian with split bark armor, a hanging root beard and a luminous seed-heart inside its hollow chest.
assets.damagePlan: Next pass: armored limbs shed bark chips; a vulnerable seed-heart pulses and the torso recoils on a clean hit.
assets.attackPlan: Next pass: a root hammer slam, with an overhead windup and a spreading ground warning.
